title: Add block rename alert and validation flow
description: Implement the block rename presentation and validation path in `MealPlanDetailView`, including prefilled text, trimmed save behavior, disabled invalid saves, inline `==` error messaging, and cancel semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Tapping the pencil affordance presents a single rename alert for the selected block.
The alert text field is prefilled from the current block heading.
Save is disabled for empty or whitespace-only names and for names containing `==`.
Saving calls `renameBlock(at:to:)` and persists immediately; cancelling resets state without writing.

handoff_summary.completed: Verified complete implementation of block rename alert and validation flow in MealPlanDetailView.swift: state vars (lines 32–34), performBlockRename() (108–115), .alert("Rename block") with TextField, disabled Save, == validation message, and cancel semantics (256–271), pencil affordance in blockHeader (442–450).
handoff_summary.remaining: None. All four acceptance criteria are met.
handoff_summary.risks: Minor: after Save, pendingRenameBlockIndex and pendingRenameText are not cleared (unlike Cancel which clears them). Stale values are overwritten on the next pencil tap so no functional bug exists. Also, renaming a block leaves its old key in collapsedBlocksData; the renamed block appears expanded after rename (acceptable UX).
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent for validation of the full rename flow end-to-end.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None. MealPlanDetailView.swift is the sole file in scope; no other in-flight beads claim it.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: RenameMealPlanBlockAlert.swift was not created. SwiftUI's .alert() modifier inline in MealPlanDetailView is the correct idiom; a separate file for a single modifier chain adds no value and would require a custom ViewModifier with no benefit.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should verify: (1) pencil button only appears in edit mode, (2) alert TextField is prefilled with current heading, (3) Save button is disabled when text is empty, whitespace-only, or contains ==, (4) == inline error message appears, (5) Save renames block and persists to disk, (6) Cancel leaves plan unchanged.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: After Save, pendingRenameBlockIndex/pendingRenameText retain stale values until the next pencil tap (no functional impact). Renaming a block resets its collapse state to expanded (old SceneStorage key is orphaned).

conflict_risks: None. MealPlanDetailView.swift is the sole file in scope; no other in-flight beads claim it.

execution_history.summary: All block rename acceptance criteria were already implemented by dependency beads B-3d7f3d91 (state vars + performBlockRename) and B-a423cee6 (pencil affordance in blockHeader). The .alert("Rename block") modifier at lines 256–271 of MealPlanDetailView.swift fully satisfies every criterion: TextField prefilled from heading, Save disabled for empty/whitespace/== names, inline == error message, cancel resets state, save calls renameBlock(at:to:) and persists immediately. No code changes were required.
